bagPolicy.summary: Bags must fit comfortably under your seat and be no larger than 22" x 14" x 9". Oversized bags are prohibited.
allowed: Bags up to 22" x 14" x 9" that fit under your seat
bagPolicy.note: This is the bag rule printed on MSG's Radio City concert event pages. The Radio City FAQ on msg.com does not display its answers to automated readers, so the linked event page (October 2, 2027) is the source. The full prohibited items list is in the Radio City FAQ on msg.com.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Radio City Music Hall can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: There is no designated rideshare zone. Meet your driver on 6th Avenue between 50th and 51st Streets.

concessions.note: Radio City Music Hall offers a variety of food and drink options, including classic concessions and specialty items. Guests can enjoy a range of snacks and beverages, with highlights such as gourmet hot dogs and artisanal cocktails. The venue also features unique offerings tailored to enhance the event experience.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: For accessible accommodations, contact the Madison Square Garden Accessibility Services Department at 888-609-7599 or accessibilityservices@msg.com, Monday through Friday, 9 a.m. to 6 p.m.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Radio City Music Hall's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Radio City Music Hall. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Use the Radio City Music Hall entrances on 50th and 51st Streets between 5th and 6th Avenues.
